about: Every joyo kanji a player may guess, as rows of `fields`. Parts are [tile, position] or [tile, position, form]; tiles are data/parts.json's. Written by tools/compile_game.py from data/candidates.json.

両: counter for carriages (e.g., in a train)
条: counter for articles, clauses, paragraphs, etc.
枚: counter for flat thin objects or sheets
階: counter for storeys of a building
